### Integrated Brier Score

```{r}
# Initialize list to store IBS scores for each cross-validation result
ibs_scores_list <- list()

# Loop over each cross-validation result object using lapply
ibs_scores_list <- lapply(cv_results_list, function(res_obj) {
  # Apply function over each element in the result object (each fold in cross-validation)
  sapply(res_obj, function(res) {
    # Check if row counts match between actual_surv and actual_test
    if (nrow(res$actual_surv) != nrow(res$actual_test)) {
      stop("Row count mismatch between actual_surv and actual_test")
    }
    
    # Define test data
    test_data <- cbind(res$actual_surv, res$actual_test)
    
    # Time points in test data
    times_test <- sort(unique(test_data$OS_months))
    if(!0 %in% times_test){
    times_test <- c(0, times_test) # Add timepoint 0 as baseline (if not included)
    }
    
    # Time points in prediction
    times_pred <- res$predictions$unique.death.times
    
    # Find the nearest indices for each desired time in the unique death times
    time_indices <- sapply(times_test, function(t) which.min(abs(times_pred - t)))
    
    # Extract predicted survival probabilities at the specified times
    aligned_surv_probs <- res$predictions$survival[, time_indices, drop = FALSE]
    
    # Calculate prediction error curve (PEC)
    pec_obj <- pec(
      object = list("BlockForest" = aligned_surv_probs),
      formula = Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ 1,
      cens.model = "marginal",
      exact = TRUE,
      data = test_data
    )
    
    # Define the time range of interest for IBS
    IBSrange <- quantile(test_data$OS_months, 0.9)
    #IBSrange <- median(test_data$OS_months)
    #IBSrange <- max(test_data$OS_months)
    
    # Calculate the CRPS and extract the IBS score
    crps_val <- crps(pec_obj, start = 0, times = IBSrange)
    ibs_score <- crps_val[2] # Adjust if necessary based on your specific data structure
    
    return(ibs_score)
  })
})

# Convert scores to dataframe
out_ibs <- data.frame(fold = 1:10, t(do.call("rbind", ibs_scores_list))[1:10,]) %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(.), names_to = "model", values_to = "IBS")

# Plot
library(ggpubr)
ggplot(out_ibs, aes(x = reorder(model,-IBS), y = IBS, fill = model))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)+
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5,1))+
  theme_classic()+
  stat_compare_means(ref.group = "IMC_ALL", paired = FALSE, method = "t.test", method.args = list(alternative = "less", label = "p.format"))+
  #stat_compare_means(vjust = 1, method = "anova")+
  #scale_fill_manual(values = col_cv)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Models")+
  ylab("Integrated Brier Score")
```



### Concordance (Uno)

```{r}
# Initialize list to store concordance scores for each cross-validation result
concordance_scores_list <- list()

# Loop over each cross-validation result object using lapply
concordance_scores_list <- lapply(cv_results_list, function(res_obj) {
  # Apply function over each element in the result object (each fold in cross-validation)
  sapply(res_obj, function(res) {
    out <- concordance(Surv(res$actual_surv[, 1], res$actual_surv[, 2]) ~ rowSums(res$predictions$survival), timewt = "n/G2")
    return(out$concordance)
  })
})

out_concordance <- data.frame(fold = 1:10, t(do.call("rbind", concordance_scores_list))[1:10,]) %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(.), names_to = "model", values_to = "concordance")

#out_concordance <- rbind(out_concordance, fit_cox_out)

library(ggpubr)
ggplot(out_concordance, aes(x = reorder(model,concordance), y = concordance, fill = model))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5,1))+
  theme_classic()+
  stat_compare_means(ref.group = "IMC_ALL", paired = FALSE, method = "t.test", method.args = list(alternative = "greater", label = "p.format"))+
  #stat_compare_means(vjust = 1, method = "anova")+
  #scale_fill_manual(values = col_cv)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Models")+
  ylab("Concordance (Uno)")
```

### Check specific model 

#### Kaplan-Meier and risk group definition

```{r}
dataset <- cv_results_1
surv_plots <- list()
data_out <- list()

for(i in seq_along(dataset)){
  res <- dataset[[i]]
  out <- cbind(res$actual_surv,chf = rowSums(res$predictions$chf))
  out_df <- out %>% mutate(risk_group = ifelse(chf > median(chf), "high", "low"), fold = i) %>% rownames_to_column("PID")

  #Plot specific survival curves
  fit <- survfit(Surv(out_df$OS_months, out_df$status_OS) ~ risk_group, data = out_df)

  surv_plots[[i]] <- fit
  data_out[[i]] <- out_df
}

# Plot all curves for each CV fold
library(survival)
library(survminer)
ggsurvplot_list(surv_plots, 
                data = data_out,
                risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
                risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
                linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
                surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
                ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
                palette = "Set1",
                conf.int = TRUE
                )

## Pick a specific fold
ggsurvplot(surv_plots[[2]], 
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          palette = "Set1",
          conf.int = TRUE
)

# Display averaged chf across all folds
data_comb <- do.call("rbind", data_out)

data_comb <- data_comb %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_chf = mean(chf)) %>% select(PID, OS_months, status_OS, mean_chf) %>% unique() %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(risk_group = ifelse(mean_chf > median(mean_chf), "high", "low"))

fit <- survfit(Surv(data_comb$OS_months, data_comb$status_OS) ~ risk_group, data = data_comb)

ggsurvplot(fit, 
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          palette = "Set1",
          conf.int = TRUE
)
```

#### Importance

##### Feature-level

```{r}
variable_importance <- sapply(cv_results_1, function(res) {
  res$variable_importance
})

# Scaled importance per fold
plot <- variable_importance %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("feature") %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(.),names_to = "fold", values_to = "importance") %>% group_by(fold) %>% mutate(scaled_importance = scale(importance))

plot$scaled_importance_total <- as.vector(scale(plot$importance))

## FOR IMC-only models
# Add feature information
plot$feature_origin <- ifelse(str_detect(plot$feature, "_TU"), "TU", 
                            ifelse(str_detect(plot$feature, "_MY"), "MY", 
                                   ifelse(str_detect(plot$feature, "_T_"), "T", NA)))

plot$feature_type <- ifelse(str_detect(plot$feature, "_EXP"), "EXP", 
                            ifelse(str_detect(plot$feature, "_MC"), "MC", 
                                   ifelse(str_detect(plot$feature, "_D"), "D", 
                                          ifelse(str_detect(plot$feature, "_INT"), "INT", NA)))) 

plot$feature_spatial <- ifelse(plot$feature_type %in% c("EXP", "MC"), "non_spatial", ifelse(plot$feature_type %in% c("D", "INT"), "spatial", NA))

# Define colors 
col_origin <- setNames(c("lightblue", "blueviolet", "orchid1"),c("TU", "MY", "T"))

col_type <- setNames(c("#1F78B4","#A6CEE3", "#B2DF8A", "#33A02C"),c("EXP", "MC", "INT", "D"))

col_spatial <- setNames(c("#377EB8","#4DAF4A"),c("non_spatial", "spatial"))
```


```{r}
ggplot(plot, aes(x = reorder(feature,-scaled_importance), y = scaled_importance, fill = feature_origin))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  guides(fill = "none")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_origin)+
  ylab("Scaled importance")+
  xlab("Feature")

ggplot(plot, aes(x = reorder(feature,-scaled_importance_total), y = scaled_importance_total, fill = feature_origin))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  guides(fill = "none")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_origin)+
  ylab("Scaled importance")+
  xlab("Feature")

ggplot(plot, aes(x = reorder(feature_type,-scaled_importance), y = scaled_importance, fill = feature_type))+
  geom_jitter(color = "darkgrey", position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)+
  theme_classic()+
  facet_grid(~feature_origin, scales = "free")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_type)+
  stat_compare_means(method = "anova")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  #guides(fill = "none")+
  ylab("Scaled importance")+
  xlab("Feature")

ggplot(plot, aes(x = reorder(feature_spatial,-scaled_importance), y = scaled_importance, fill = feature_spatial))+
  facet_grid(~feature_origin, scales = "free")+
  geom_jitter(color = "darkgrey", position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_spatial)+
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test")+
  #guides(fill = "none")+
  ylab("Scaled importance")+
  xlab("Feature")
```


```{r}
# Order features by median importance
ordered_features <- plot %>% group_by(feature) %>% summarize(median = median(scaled_importance)) %>% arrange(desc(median))

ggplot(ordered_features, aes(x = reorder(feature,-median), y = median))+
  geom_point(color = "black")+
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey25")+
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "lightgrey")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
heatmap <- plot %>% ungroup %>% select(feature, fold, scaled_importance) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "fold", names_from = "feature", values_from = "scaled_importance") %>% column_to_rownames("fold")

heatmap <- heatmap[,match(ordered_features$feature, colnames(heatmap))]

anno <- plot %>% ungroup %>% select(feature, feature_origin, feature_type, feature_spatial) %>% unique()
anno <- anno[match(colnames(heatmap), anno$feature),]


HeatmapAnnotation(
  boxplot = anno_boxplot(heatmap, 
                         gp = gpar(fill = "darkgrey"), box_width = 0.75,
                         height = unit(6,"cm"),
                         show_row_names = FALSE), 
  origin = anno$feature_origin, 
  type = anno$feature_type, 
  spatial = anno$feature_spatial,
  col = list(origin = col_origin,
             type = col_type,
             spatial = col_spatial),
  text = anno_text(colnames(heatmap)),
  gap = unit(1,"mm"),
  border = TRUE
)%v%NULL
```

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

cur_surv <- metadata_selected %>% select(PID, OS_months, status_OS, CLIN_age, CLIN_gender, CLIN_pT_simple, PID_group_test) %>% unique()

covariates_null <- cur_surv %>% select(-PID, -OS_months, -status_OS, -PID_group_test) %>% colnames
multi_formula_null <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates_null, collapse = " + ")))
multi_model_null <- coxph(multi_formula_null, data = cur_surv)

covariates_full <- cur_surv %>% select(-PID, -OS_months, -status_OS) %>% colnames
multi_formula_full <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates_full, collapse = " + ")))
multi_model_full <- coxph(multi_formula_full, data = cur_surv)

#cur_surv is.na(cur_surv$PID_metagroups)

# Log-likelihood ratio test
anova(multi_model_null, multi_model_full)
```

```{r}
# Patient group info 
cur_groups <- metadata_selected %>% select(PID, TME_activated, TME_silent, TME_suppressed) %>% unique()

# Other groups
## Here GOI all 
cur_test <- metadata_selected %>% select(PID, ICAM1_driven_adhesion, mTOR_driven_growth, Not_ICAM_mTOR_driven_neutral) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% t()

# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each gene
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("TME_activated", "TME_silent","TME_suppressed"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_test, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  
  return(fisher_results)
  }

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.1 with trends
fisher_full$result <- ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.05, "UP",
                             ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.05, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

## hierarchical clustering on odds_ratio
cur_df <- fisher_full %>% select(gene, category, odds_ratio) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = odds_ratio, names_from = gene)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$gene <- factor(fisher_full$gene, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


ggplot(fisher_full, aes(x=category, y = gene,col = odds_ratio, size = -log10(p_adj)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = fisher_full,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_adj), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
cur_groups <- metadata_genome %>% select(PID, TME_activated, TME_silent, TME_suppressed) %>% unique()

# Binary mutation matrix
## Here GOI clonal 
cur_mut_clonal <- metadata_genome %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, GOI_clonal) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% t()

# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each gene
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("TME_activated", "TME_silent","TME_suppressed"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_mut_clonal, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  
  return(fisher_results)
  }

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.1 with trends
fisher_full$result <- ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.1, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.1, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

# Replace INF values with max
fisher_full$odds_ratio[fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf] <- max(fisher_full$odds_ratio[!fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf])

## hierarchical clustering on odds_ratio
cur_df <- fisher_full %>% select(gene, category, odds_ratio) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = odds_ratio, names_from = gene)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$gene <- factor(fisher_full$gene, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


ggplot(fisher_full, aes(x=category, y = gene,col = odds_ratio, size = -log10(p_adj)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = fisher_full,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_adj), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
sce_myeloid <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_07.rds")

sce_myeloid <- sce_myeloid[,str_detect(sce_myeloid$celltype_combined, "MY")]

# Add patient groups
sce_myeloid$immune_activated <- metadata_selected$immune_activated[match(sce_myeloid$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]
sce_myeloid$immune_suppressed <- metadata_selected$immune_suppressed[match(sce_myeloid$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]
sce_myeloid$immune_silent <- metadata_selected$immune_silent[match(sce_myeloid$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]
sce_myeloid$immune_presenting <- metadata_selected$immune_presenting[match(sce_myeloid$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]
```

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

DA <- lapply(c("immune_activated", "immune_suppressed", "immune_silent", "immune_presenting"), function(x){

abundances <- table(sce_myeloid$celltype_combined, sce_myeloid$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce_myeloid)[match(colnames(abundances), sce_myeloid$PID),]

meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.1, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.1 with trends
DA_out$result <- ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

## hierarchical clustering on logFC
cur_df <- DA_out %>% select(cluster, category, logFC) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = logFC, names_from = cluster)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order


DA_out$cluster <- factor(DA_out$cluster, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

DA <- lapply(c("immune_activated", "immune_suppressed", "immune_silent", "immune_presenting"), function(x){

abundances <- table(sce_tumor$celltype_combined, sce_tumor$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce_tumor)[match(colnames(abundances), sce_tumor$PID),]

meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.1, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.1 with trends
DA_out$result <- ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

## hierarchical clustering on logFC
cur_df <- DA_out %>% select(cluster, category, logFC) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = logFC, names_from = cluster)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order


DA_out$cluster <- factor(DA_out$cluster, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```
